_what: What every tool's description tells an AI about how to behave around it, said once from the tool's own four hints (src/tool-behavior-notes.mjs), so the words an AI reads and the hints an AI app obeys can never disagree. Each row: `when` names hint values that must all match, `say` is the sentence added after the description, `unless` are words that, when the description already says the same thing, stop the sentence being added twice. Rows are tried in order. A hint left out matches nothing (the cautious reading is the app's, not this file's). Adding a rule is one row.

rows.say: Reads only: it changes nothing and is safe to call to look.
Can remove or overwrite something the person kept: confirm with the person before calling it unless they already asked for exactly this.
Adds or sets only: calling it again with the same input changes nothing more.
It reaches outside the person's own Trillion, so what it sends cannot be taken back by Trillion.
